comment: Modules a user may reasonably expect but that this playground cannot provide. Used to turn 'Module not found' into an accurate explanation. Matched by prefix on the dot boundary, after checking the bundled packages and the embedded base, so anything those do provide (e.g. ghc-compat's GHC.Stack, Language.Haskell.TH.Syntax) is classified as available first. `embedded` lists the extra modules the wasm bundle itself provides: it embeds canvhs, which is never built as a .pkg, so it is absent from the build's module maps. Check candidates with `node scripts/node-repl-run.js --probe-imports <Module>,...`.

unavailable.reason: Template Haskell is not supported by MicroHs (only its types, via ghc-compat)
GHC internal modules are not exposed by MicroHs
POSIX-only modules are not available in the browser
Windows-only modules are not available in the browser
networking is not available in this playground
not shipped: it compiles, but its reader (Data.Binary.Get / decode) loops forever in this build
the bundle ships canvhs's Audio.AudHs.Sound and Audio.AudHs.FFI, but not its umbrella module
